description: Did this Base payment settle? Status, block, timestamp and confirmations for one transaction hash, with its ERC-20 Transfers decoded (token, from, to, amount; up to 100 listed, transfers_total gives the full count) and any EIP-3009 authorization used, plus match flags for an optional expected payTo and amount, so an x402 PAYMENT-RESPONSE can be checked. Required: hash. $0.002 USDC on Base. Transaction not found, no charge. No account, no API key. Base mainnet only. By Ontario Protocol. [PAID: 0.002 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: a call without payment returns MCP PaymentRequired; the retry carries the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta['x402/payment']. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Signing happens in the caller's wallet.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

expected_amount.description: Optional USDC amount in atomic units, for example 500000 for 0.5 USDC.

expected_to.description: Optional payTo address the USDC transfer should reach.

name: ontario_base-tx-check

transfers.description: ERC-20 Transfers in log order, up to 100; transfers_total gives the full count.

title: Base Transaction Check

x402.not_for: Not proof that an HTTP x402 request caused the transfer, and not other chains.
x402.purchase_reason: Confirm that an x402 settlement or USDC payment landed on Base, to the expected address and for the expected amount.
x402.selection_rule: Returns one Base transaction's status, block, timestamp, confirmations, decoded ERC-20 transfers (up to 100 listed; transfers_total gives the full count) and EIP-3009 authorizations, with optional expected payTo and amount match flags. A hash that is not found is not charged.
